title: From Ashes to New Score Second Straight Mainstream Rock Airplay No. 1 With ‘Die for You’
summary: The band joins Shinedown and Three Days Grace as the only acts with multiple leaders in 2026.
contentText:
From Ashes to New returns to No. 1 on Billboard ’s Mainstream Rock Airplay chart (dated Oct. 17) with “Die for You.”

Released in March via Better Noise Music, the track reaches the summit with a 7% increase in plays at the format during the Oct. 2-8 tracking week, according to Luminate.

“Die for You” earns the Pennsylvania rockers their second career radio No. 1, after “Drag Me” led Mainstream Rock Airplay in May. The band first appeared on the chart in 2016 via “Through It All,” which rose to No. 6. “Die for You” is the band’s eighth top 10.

From Ashes to New is the third act to notch multiple No. 1s on Mainstream Rock Airplay in 2026, joining Shinedown (three) and Three Days Grace (two).

“Die for You” is the fourth single off From Ashes to New’s fifth studio album, Reflections , released in April.

The No. 1 also gives Better Noise its fourth No. 1 of 2026, following the Funeral Portrait’s “Dark Thoughts” in January, “Drag Me” and Five Finger Death Punch’s “Eye of the Storm” in July. The label ties BMG for the most leaders so far this year.

Better Noise led all labels in Mainstream Rock Airplay No. 1s in both 2025 (with five) and 2024 (four).

The label has now earned 24 No. 1s this decade, extending its lead among all labels. Concord has the second-most, with 18, followed by RCA (14), Warner (13), Republic (11), Atlantic and BMG (10 each).

All of Billboard ’s charts dated Oct. 17 will update Tuesday, Oct. 13, on Billboard.com.
